data.explanation: This letter confirms a new newspaper subscription you ordered. The print edition starts on 25 June 2027 (the e-paper is already active) and costs €42.90 a month. The subscription runs for a minimum of 12 months and then continues indefinitely unless cancelled with one month's notice to the end of the minimum term (or later, to the end of any month). No action is needed now; just keep this confirmation for your records and note the cancellation terms if you ever want to end it.
